entry_points.summary: Read-only Sonnet single-dimension auditor; writes findings file, returns counts.
Sonnet policy-mining agent; wraps axiom-extract.py; proposes <=5 axiom candidates; never writes store.
Haiku mechanical bisect runner; returns offending SHA+diff; refuses destructive repros and interpretive work.
/z-plan-split leaf planner; writes cluster SPEC/PLAN/TASKS, escalates risky decisions.
Haiku task classifier returning low|medium|high for model routing.
Primary provider proxy; expected_contract: freeform; supports 12 modes including generate-hypotheses-round1/round2-adversarial.
Secondary provider proxy; expected_contract: freeform; same 12-mode surface as primary, distinct provider role.
Haiku subagent that folds events.jsonl delta + git diff + TASKS.md + prior SESSION.md into bounded SESSION.md handoff at /z-execute batch breakpoint.
Read-only Haiku fetcher over INDEX/concept JSON/MEMORIES-FLAT.md; returns synthesis.
Refreshes one concept doc pair; preserves memories[] verbatim; dry-run default; dedup_tags support.
Haiku web/API retrieval worker; emits lookup-contract envelope; verb-blocklist enforced.
Haiku wide-mode brainstorm clustering agent; collapses N peer ideator framings into K distinct directions by approach axis; read-only; returns effective-diversity report for Phase 3 ranked briefing.

Implements one task block; supports --tasks path override, cross_task_notes, tests_md_path; produces RATIONALE/TRIED/DEVIATIONS contract fields for Tier 2 design rationale; mandatory self-check with 7 items including TESTS.md coverage.
Cheap Haiku planning-depth classifier; returns quick|standard|deep level for INTENT.md richness; advisory only; dispatched by /z-plan when planning_mode=intent and intent_level=auto.
Sonnet branch-diff quality reviewer; deep=true triggers Opus abstraction sub-pass; dedup+consensus+dismissal merge.
Sonnet plan artifact style reviewer; 7 categories; multi-voice; returns fenced JSON+Summary.
Haiku advisory router; primary routes include /z-map (terrain) and /z-research (synthesis); needs_research deprecated alias.
Cheap Haiku first-pass pre-reviewer; opt-in (Z_HARNESS_PRE_REVIEW=1); runs up to 3 in parallel; produces preliminary blockers/majors for real reviewers.
Opus final-judge synthesizer for /z-research; 10-section RESEARCH.md; forbidden from new design recommendations; read-only.
Haiku mechanical remote verifier: two-level rsync sandbox; atomic mkdir-lock+.base-ready; step-7 NEVER-delete guard for base/.
Reference for workflow question resolver (scripts/config.py cmd_resolve_question); maps question_id to skip|prefill|ask|halt|defer-to-sink.
Haiku post-run memory candidate generator; debug_md_path primary for debug runs; slug anti-patterns enforced.
Provider proxy for task correctness/spec review; validates implementer RATIONALE/TRIED/DEVIATIONS against diff; expected_contract: review-verdict; FOLLOWUPS: fenced JSON for minors/nits.
Haiku plan-scope extractor; emits JSON array of file changes with explicit|inferred|broad|unknown confidence; seeds active-plan registry.
Haiku Phase-0 scope classifier for z-audit and z-brainstorm; returns LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY + axis + chunks manifest; advisory only.
Sonnet post-fanout reconciler for HEAVY z-audit runs; dedupes N per-chunk findings, preserves cross-chunk dissent verbatim; never writes to disk.
Sonnet post-fanout reconciler for HEAVY z-brainstorm runs; concatenates N per-chunk BRAINSTORM.md files; anti-bias check; chosen_framing: pending.
Opus self-review fallback when Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off; expected_contract: review-verdict; no external CLI call.
Haiku preflight verifier for SPEC references; uses relevant_docs LLM JSONs as second source of truth.

Sonnet BFS-level task generator for Adaptive INTENT engine; reads frozen INTENT.md + LEDGER.md; emits one independent sibling-task batch per level; writes canonical TASKS.md format parsed by session-helpers.sh; default level cap 6; emits termination sentinel on cap/budget guard.
Flash subagent for Tier 1 per-task mechanical doc sync; diff-only surgical updates to AUTO-START/AUTO-END fields; stages to tier1-staged/; reconcile via reconcile-tier1-staged.py.

invariants: Each agent is spawned fresh per invocation; callers pass all required context.
Commands/skills own orchestration, user interaction, artifact writes, and final routing decisions.
consultant-primary, consultant-secondary, and reviewer resolve providers via scripts/resolve-provider.sh.
Proxy agents emit consult_start before provider calls so liveness checks can detect hangs.

consultant-primary and consultant-secondary declare expected_contract: freeform; binding a persona with contract: review-verdict or contract: strict-json to either role fails resolve-persona.py validate.
reviewer and self-reviewer declare expected_contract: review-verdict; binding a persona with contract: freeform to either role fails resolve-persona.py validate.
Personas that omit the contract field are treated as 'any' and pass all role contract checks.
doc-updater must preserve existing memories[] verbatim and never author memories.
external-lookup must follow docs/llm/lookup-contract.json and refuse mutating commands.
planning-router is read-only and advisory; malformed or unsafe routing returns ask_user/bad_input.
planning-router reason code needs_research is a deprecated alias for needs_terrain_map (routes to /z-map); callers should emit needs_terrain_map instead.
mr-reviewer reviews quality, not correctness, and returns JSON for the orchestrator to write.
plan-style-reviewer reviews design-quality of plan artifacts, not correctness; never finds logic/correctness/race-condition bugs.
plan-style-reviewer never writes PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md; orchestrator does.
plan-style-reviewer style-drift findings must cite a STYLE.md rule ID; premature-abstraction findings must cite file:line.
remote-runner executes mechanical checks only; interpretive debugging returns to the caller.
remote-runner delegates sandbox lifecycle to scripts/remote-sandbox-sync.sh.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh validates SLUG and TASK_ID: rejects values containing '/', '..', single-quotes, empty string; TASK_ID cannot equal the literal string 'base'.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh uses atomic mkdir for .base.lock; the lock winner seeds <slug>/base/ and writes .base-ready marker containing local HEAD SHA; concurrent losers poll for the marker up to 600 s.
remote-runner step 7 NEVER deletes <slug>/base/; only the per-task <slug>/<task-id>/ directory is removed on success.
cluster-planner refuses nested plan-split outputs when an ancestor MANIFEST.md exists.
review-agent never writes; orchestrator owns all writes via /z-suggest-memory.
review-agent returns exactly one fenced JSON block; any other form is treated as malformed.
review-agent parent_command=debug: debug_md_path is primary artifact; spec_path is supplementary.
bisect-isolator always runs git bisect reset in a finally-block trap; never leaves repo in bisect-in-progress state.
bisect-isolator runs a sanity gate verifying the repro inverts across the range before git bisect run.
bisect-isolator never interprets the offending commit; returns SHA+diff only.
implementer's cross_task_notes target task must exist in the same TASKS.md; absent target is logged and silently skipped.
implementer's RATIONALE field is required on every return; TRIED and DEVIATIONS are optional.
implementer's TRIED entries are self-reported and unverifiable by reviewers beyond code consistency.
implementer's DEVIATIONS are validated by the reviewer against the diff.
spec-precheck and reviewer both consume relevant_docs LLM JSONs as a second source of truth alongside SPEC.
scope-probe is advisory only; the orchestrator owns the final dispatch decision.
scope-probe never invents axis names; only names from the caller-supplied axis_taxonomy or the special value 'none' on refusal are valid returns.
scope-probe archive file is written before the live file (archive-first invariant); if archive write fails, Phase 0 aborts.
scope-reconciler-audit never smooths over chunk dissent; both conflicting findings appear verbatim in the Cross-chunk dissent section.
scope-reconciler-audit never writes to disk; it returns REPORT.md content and CHUNK_ARTIFACTS for the orchestrator to persist.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm always sets chosen_framing: pending; any other value is a spec violation.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm never drops a failed chunk silently; every chunk ID from the input array must appear as either a Chunk or Chunk FAILED section.
research-judge is FORBIDDEN from proposing new design recommendations; every claim must trace back to MAP.md, BRAINSTORM.md, or a panel perspective file.
research-judge self-check (Step 7) is mandatory on every invocation; research_judge_temptation field is always populated.
research-judge produces exactly 10 sections in fixed order; no additional top-level sections permitted.
research-judge fires panel_degraded mode when panel_perspective_count < 3; synthesis continues with available perspectives.
research-judge returns STATUS: unable_to_complete when perspectives array is empty or MAP.md/BRAINSTORM.md is missing.
reviewer **FOLLOWUPS:** block is optional; when present it MUST appear after ### Major and MUST contain exactly one fenced json array.
reviewer minors and nits MUST be placed in **FOLLOWUPS:** (P3/P2) and are never silently dropped.
reviewer validates implementer RATIONALE for plausibility, DEVIATIONS against diff, and TRIED for code consistency.
reviewer **FOLLOWUPS:** block is parsed by scripts/parse-followups-block.py; parse failure logs followup_block_parse_failed and never crashes the reviewer return path.
self-reviewer has the same **FOLLOWUPS:** contract as reviewer and emits the same review_start/review_end telemetry.
self-reviewer MUST NOT call resolve-provider.sh or any external CLI; it reviews the diff directly.
resolver result domain: skip|prefill|ask|halt|defer-to-sink; all five are valid results from scripts/config.py cmd_resolve_question.
resolver defer-to-sink: orchestrator must NOT prompt the user; must call scripts/sink-add.sh and log followup_deferred_from_resolver; must fall back to ask if sink-add.sh exits non-zero.
resolver defer-to-sink is a result-domain value only; it does not appear in VALIDATORS or QUESTION_IDS[id][choices].
resolver defer-to-sink is never applied by the overnight gate (_apply_overnight_overrides); it is a config-layer result only.
scope-extractor output is consumed exclusively by scripts/active-plan-registry.py update-scope; the agent emits only valid JSON to stdout.
scope-extractor never emits absolute paths; all path values in its output are repo-relative.
axiom-extractor proposes only; it never writes the axiom store (candidates/, approved/, rejected/) and never approves a candidate.
tier1-doc-updater is a mechanical agent: no reasoning, no prose writing, diff-only surgical updates.
tier1-doc-updater NEVER writes to docs/human/ or docs/llm/ directly; all output goes to $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/tier1-staged/.
tier1-doc-updater only modifies content within AUTO-START/AUTO-END delimited sections in human docs.
pre-reviewer is opt-in only, gated by Z_HARNESS_PRE_REVIEW=1; produces preliminary findings; never blocks.
context-curator is mechanical only; folds telemetry into SESSION.md; never edits production code.
ideator-clusterer is read-only; it returns structured text for the orchestrator to incorporate into the Phase 3 briefing; it never writes files.
ideator-clusterer must name every ideator ID from the input list either as a cluster representative or in the Collapsed framings section; silent omission is a spec violation.
ideator-clusterer K=1 (all framings converged) is a valid outcome; the agent must not artificially inflate K.
ideator-clusterer cross-cluster consensus section is mandatory even when empty (report 'None detected.').
intent-classifier is advisory only; the orchestrator announces the pick and lets the user override inline.
intent-classifier returns LEVEL: standard when the task prompt is empty or malformed so the orchestrator can proceed.
intent-classifier makes at most 3 file reads before defaulting to standard when signals are unclear.
task-tree-generator emits only tasks that advance criteria listed in unmet_criteria; it does not invent acceptance criteria.
task-tree-generator: all tasks in one level batch MUST be independent (no intra-level dependencies); **Depends on:** is always a literal dash.
task-tree-generator: canonical heading format ## T<NNN> - <title> `[ ]` is machine-parsed by session-helpers.sh; any deviation silently breaks task-status detection.
task-tree-generator: when level >= level_cap or budget_tokens_remaining < 30000, it emits a single termination sentinel task and returns STATUS: termination_guard.
task-tree-generator NEVER writes INTENT.md or LEDGER.md; it writes only to tasks_output_path.
task-tree-generator: default level cap is 6 (levels 0-5 may produce normal batches; level 6 triggers termination).
gotchas: reviewer and self-reviewer emit **FOLLOWUPS:** fenced JSON array block after ### Major; minors/nits MUST go here. Orchestrator parses via scripts/parse-followups-block.py and calls scripts/sink-add.sh per entry. Parse failure logs followup_block_parse_failed and continues. Required per-entry fields: priority, name, recommended_command, cited_paths. Optional: recommended_command_safe_to_retry (default false), auto_close_eligible (default false; reviewer on producer-class allowlist may set true).

self-reviewer is invoked when Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off; it is Opus-model and reads the diff directly without any provider CLI. It still emits review_start/review_end telemetry in the same shape as reviewer.
scope-extractor is best-effort non-fatal: if seeding fails, active-plan-registry.py self-logs registry_error and the run continues. Overlap detection for the current run may miss some files.
axiom-extractor returns a fenced JSON array; no auto-approve happens. Candidates must go through /z-axiom-approve before entering the axiom store.

resolver new result class defer-to-sink: orchestrator must NOT invoke AskUserQuestion; must call scripts/sink-add.sh with question context as entry body, log followup_deferred_from_resolver, then proceed. If sink-add.sh exits non-zero, fall back to ask -- question cannot be silently dropped.
codex-consultant.md, gemini-consultant.md, and codex-reviewer.md are stale names.
check-timeout.sh is sourced by proxy agents; missing timeout/gtimeout leaves TIMEOUT_CMD empty.
planning-router must not infer missing quantitative signals from filesystem exploration.
planning-router needs_research reason code is a deprecated alias for needs_terrain_map -- callers should migrate to needs_terrain_map.
doc-updater dry-run returns proposed docs; /z-maintain-docs decides whether to write them.
external-lookup's canonical contract is lookup-contract.json, not only inline agent prose.
remote-runner refuses DB writes, real-money operations, destructive ops, and interpretive work.
remote-runner refuses naked binary restarts; must use qtctl up <paper-manifest>, not direct binary invocation.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh resolves remote home via SSH before building --link-dest paths; tilde expansion is unreliable inside --link-dest on the remote side.
TASK_ID cannot be the literal string 'base'; remote-sandbox-sync.sh exits 2 on that value to prevent collisions with the shared warm-base directory.

If remote-sandbox-sync.sh dies between .base.lock acquisition and release, the lock persists and all future seeding invocations timeout after 600 s. Recovery: ssh <remote-host> 'rmdir ~/dev/qt-bot-sandbox/<slug>/.base.lock'.
On seed rsync failure, remote-sandbox-sync.sh cleans up the partial <slug>/base/ dir before releasing the lock so losers do not unblock onto a corrupt base.
mr-reviewer never writes MR-REVIEW.md; callers parse its fenced JSON response.
mr-reviewer Opus sub-pass fires only when mode=abstraction-only AND deep=true.
plan-style-reviewer: dismissed_signatures.json suppresses previously dismissed findings via Jaccard >= 0.6 match.
plan-style-reviewer: voices that return malformed JSON are logged as plan_style_voice_failed and skipped (no retry).
spec-precheck validates factual SPEC references, not design quality or runtime semantics.
doc-fetcher Ripgrep is a soft dependency; falls back to Python word-boundary scan if rg is missing.

review-agent caps candidates at 3 and emits [] rather than padding; slug anti-patterns banned (PR-number refs, library-name-alone, session-specific names, negative-capability claims, model-specific slugs).
review-agent debug mode: debug_md_path must be passed when parent_command=debug; absent for implement-all/review-all.
bisect-isolator refusal checks use POSIX-ERE split patterns (not Perl lookaheads) for macOS/BSD grep compat.
bisect-isolator returns bisect_unusable (not refused) when the repro does not invert across the good/bad ref range.
bisect-isolator captures ORIG_HEAD before any checkout and installs cleanup_bisect trap covering refusal-after-checkout paths.
consultant modes generate-hypotheses-round1 and generate-hypotheses-round2-adversarial return RAW (no standard wrapper); callers must parse provider output directly.
implementer's cross_task_notes are optional; omitting the field or emitting [] is backward-compatible.
implementer's RATIONALE is required on every return; TRIED and DEVIATIONS are optional.
implementer's TRIED entries are self-reported and unverifiable by reviewers; reviewers can only check code consistency (e.g., if TRIED claims tokio::spawn was attempted but code still imports tokio).
implementer's TESTS.md coverage check (self-check item 6): a test that compiles and passes but doesn't fail on deliberate invariant violation is trivial and must be strengthened.
scope-probe caps walked candidates at 4 to keep context cheap; walking more than 4 is a violation.
scope-probe makes at most one doc-fetcher call (step 4); chaining doc-fetcher calls is a violation.
scope-probe output must have exactly one fenced JSON block; line-prefix headers (STATUS, MODE, AXIS, etc.) must appear before the fence, never inside it.
scope-probe returns STATUS: refused + MODE: MEDIUM when axis evidence is insufficient -- this is not an error, it is the correct graceful-degradation path.
scope-reconciler-audit severity elevation applies only to systemic non-dissent findings (same normalized_evidence_key in >=2 distinct chunks); dissent findings are never elevated.

scope-reconciler-audit normalization (lowercase, collapse whitespace, strip line-number prefix, truncate to 200 chars) is an internal computation only; the original quoted evidence is always written to REPORT.md.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm anti-bias check (sections A through D) is mandatory even when findings are empty; skipping any sub-check makes the output less trustworthy than a single chunk's output.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm: a Claude-favoring pick requires a concrete justification naming what Claude said that peers did not; a generic preference is not accepted as justification.
research-judge is FORBIDDEN from proposing new design recommendations; every claim must trace back to MAP.md, BRAINSTORM.md, or a panel perspective file.
research-judge is read-only; it returns RESEARCH.md content as text; the orchestrator writes the file.
research-judge fires panel_degraded mode when panel_perspective_count < 3; synthesis continues with available perspectives.
research-judge self-check (Step 7) is mandatory on every invocation; research_judge_temptation field is always populated.
research-judge produces exactly 10 sections in fixed order; no additional top-level sections permitted.
expected_contract mismatch: binding a persona with contract: review-verdict or contract: strict-json to consultant_primary or consultant_secondary roles fails resolve-persona.py validate.
expected_contract mismatch: binding a persona with contract: freeform to reviewer or self-reviewer role fails resolve-persona.py validate.
Personas that omit the contract field pass all role contract checks -- contract is optional in persona definitions.
scope-extractor: brace-expanded paths like skills/{z-plan,z-fix}/SKILL.md are expanded to explicit entries; paths with * or ? are emitted as broad confidence.
axiom-extractor: --historical mode is CPU/token-heavy; only invoke when the caller explicitly passed mode: historical.
tier1-doc-updater reads diff only; never reads full source files beyond what's needed to find target in doc.
tier1-doc-updater stages to $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/tier1-staged/<concept>/; reconciliation script handles final merge.
tier1-doc-updater: concept doc missing AUTO-START markers -> logged in NOTES, concept skipped.
pre-reviewer never blocks; real reviewers get final say. Pre-reviewer findings are advisory only.
pre-reviewer runs up to 3 in parallel; gated by Z_HARNESS_PRE_REVIEW=1 env var.
context-curator: outputs bounded SESSION.md; mechanical only; dispatched at /z-execute batch breakpoint.

ideator-clusterer is only dispatched when WIDE_N > 3 (wide mode). For WIDE_N <= 3, the orchestrator presents raw framings directly. If ideator-clusterer fails or returns K=0, the orchestrator falls back to presenting N raw framings.
ideator-clusterer operates on the divergence axis (N peer framings, same topic); it is distinct from scope-reconciler-brainstorm which operates on the chunk axis (sub-topics in scope).
ideator-clusterer must reproduce representative member framing blocks verbatim; paraphrasing introduces bias.
intent-classifier is dispatched only when planning_mode=intent and intent_level=auto; if intent_level is a non-auto value, the orchestrator uses it directly without calling this agent.

intent-classifier makes at most 3 file reads (stops after 3 if still unclear and defaults to standard). Checking for public surface exports (index.ts, lib.rs, __init__.py, etc.) is a soft signal toward deep.

task-tree-generator canonical heading format: backtick-enclosed [ ] status marker must be present and exactly [ ] (pending). Wrong bracket content or missing backtick will cause session-helpers.sh to silently fail task-status detection.
task-tree-generator writes only to tasks_output_path; it must not create or modify INTENT.md, LEDGER.md, or any other file.
task-tree-generator: if budget_tokens_remaining is < 50000, prefer a batch of <=3 high-confidence tasks. If < 30000, emit a termination sentinel regardless of level count.
task-tree-generator termination batch contains exactly one sentinel task; no normal task blocks are emitted alongside it.
task-tree-generator task_id_start lets the orchestrator number tasks continuously across levels (e.g. if levels 0+1 used T001-T008, pass task_id_start=9 for level 2).
